item.title: [REF] Immich MCP server tools - broaden test coverage
item.justification: Feature CF1 has test-coverage=PARTIAL. Expand tests to cover more tools and error handling.

tasks.task: Add unit tests for remaining MCP tools (server info/version, albums, libraries, asset by id)
Add tests for HTTP error and network error branches
Review coverage gaps and update tests to reach core behavior

test.description: Expanded unit tests for MCP tool coverage and error handling
test.assertions: Tool routing and error branches are exercised

item.title: [REF] Docker packaging - add smoke validation
item.justification: Feature CF2 has test-coverage=NONE. Add a minimal smoke check to validate container startup.

tasks.task: Add a simple container smoke test or scripted check for docker compose startup
Document the smoke check in README

manual-steps.step: Run the smoke check and confirm container starts without errors

item.title: Implement MCP server for Immich REST API
item.justification: Expose Immich endpoints via MCP using the OpenAPI spec as the source of truth.

security-impact.notes: Handles API tokens/keys and remote API calls; ensure secrets are not logged and TLS is required.

tasks.task: Define configuration inputs (Immich base URL, API key/token)
Ingest the OpenAPI spec and map core endpoints to MCP tools
Implement request/response handling with httpx
Add basic error handling and user-facing messages

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server and list available tools
Invoke one read-only Immich endpoint and verify a successful response

r.observations: Added config-driven Immich HTTP handling, OpenAPI spec fetch, and core MCP tools (ping, server info/version, current user).
r.lessons-learned: Use the raw GitHub URL for JSON specs to avoid HTML responses.

item.title: Adapt Immich REST API features to MCP tools
item.justification: Expand MCP tool coverage to align with core Immich REST API features.

tasks.task: Review the OpenAPI spec and select the next set of core endpoints to expose
Add MCP tools for additional read-only endpoints (e.g., assets, albums, libraries)
Support common query parameters (pagination, filters, sorting) where applicable
Document new tools and example usage in README

manual-steps.step: Start the MCP server and verify the new tools are listed
Invoke at least one newly added read-only tool and confirm the response shape

r.observations: Added read-only MCP tools for assets, albums, and libraries with pagination support, plus README documentation.
r.lessons-learned: Keep pagination parameters optional to match varied Immich endpoint behavior.

item.title: Add Docker image and docker-compose setup
item.justification: Provide a containerized workflow to build and run the MCP server with a mapped port.

tasks.task: Create a Dockerfile that installs dependencies and runs the MCP server
Add docker-compose.yml that builds the image and exposes a configurable port
Document container usage and environment variables in README

manual-steps.step: Build the image with docker compose
Start the container and verify the port is published

r.observations: Added Dockerfile and docker-compose setup with a configurable port and documented usage.
r.lessons-learned: Document stdio transport behavior to avoid confusion about exposed ports.

item.title: Implement unit-test environment for the MCP server
item.justification: Enable repeatable testing of MCP tools and HTTP interactions to reduce regressions.

tasks.task: Add a test runner and configuration (pytest) to the project
Introduce fixtures for environment configuration and HTTP mocking
Add initial unit tests for core MCP tools
Document how to run tests locally

manual-steps.step: Run the test suite and confirm a green result

r.observations: Added pytest, fixtures via monkeypatching, and initial unit tests for config, pagination, and tool wiring.
r.lessons-learned: Mocking the OpenAPI fetch and request layer keeps tests fast and offline.
